PLAN "12-Week Upper-Body Focus for Climber with Shoulder Impingement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "upper-body strength and scapular control, pain-free ROM"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation (scapular control, pain-free ROM)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..14 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..14 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..16 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..14 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x35..50 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body B":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..16 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..14 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 7m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x40..55 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Upper Body B":
        warmup:
          rowing 7m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 5x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12..14 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Body A (Deload Intensity)":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x35..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:

      DAY Thursday training 50m "Upper Body B (Deload Intensity)":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
  PHASE "Phase 2: Strength Build (progressive load, no overhead)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 7m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 5x5..8 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds

          hammer_curl 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds

      DAY Thursday training 55m "Upper Body B":
        warmup:
          rowing 7m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x4..6 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

          rear_delt_fly 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 6:

        warmup:

        cooldown:

    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m

        cooldown:

      DAY Thursday training 60m "Upper Body B":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 6x3..5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 4x12..16 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          tricep_extension 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x60..75 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Body A (Deload Volume)":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chest_fly 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Upper Body B (Deload Volume)":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x4..6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x45..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
  PHASE "Phase 3: Strength-Endurance and Climb-Specific Support" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 7m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

      DAY Thursday training 55m "Upper Body B":
